title: Yet Another Black Cell Problem
statement: Given n sorted cells (n up to 2·10^5, positions up to 10^9) plus at most x chosen extra cells, the task is the minimum k such that operations painting two cells at most k apart blacken exactly those cells. Repainting is allowed, so each black cell needs another within k: binary search k, count cells with both gaps over k, one helper serving two consecutive ones within 2k.
